title: HashiCorp Vault lists its secret engines without a token
summary: Vault lists its secret engines to a caller with no token, so anonymous requests get past its access control.  The health endpoint answering, which it does by default, is not this finding.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_matches("\"[\\w-]+/\"\\s*:\\s*\\{[^}]*\"type\"") and not body_contains("missing client token") and body_differs(control)

reproduce: curl -sk https://host/v1/sys/mounts with no X-Vault-Token header.  A list of mounts, rather than "missing client token", means anonymous access works.
remediate: Put Vault behind the network boundary it is meant to sit behind, and review whether it should be reachable here at all.
